outcome_access_rule: Protocol, generator semantics, terminal set, authority ceilings, and hostile controls are fixed before reading any new full-instance solver outcome.

normalization.justification: Any admissible sequence must span rank three because a rank-at-most-two support would exceed eta(C_5^2)=13; GL(3,5) sends an independent support triple to the standard basis.
normalization.basis_multiplicity_order: m(e1) >= m(e2) >= m(e3), obtained by permuting the selected basis triple.

encoding.multiplicity_variables: one-hot variables m1_g, m2_g, m4_g for every nonzero group point
encoding.short_zero_constraints: one inequality for every nonzero zero-sum multiset of cardinality 2 through 5; a multiset is forbidden exactly when all required multiplicity thresholds are simultaneously present
encoding.modular_sum: coordinate sums equal five times binary-encoded quotient variables
encoding.completeness: Every sorted forbidden multiset is enumerated exactly once by choosing its first k-1 points and deriving the final point from the zero-sum equation.

required: independent regeneration of the OPB digest
all hostile proof and coverage mutants rejected
no reliance on generator success flags
named theorem implying nonexistence of the registered obstruction
complete proof independent of a solver exit code

triggers: post-outcome change to encoding, normalization, thresholds, or terminal semantics

prohibited_shortcuts: Treating the internal support-through-22 ledger as theorem evidence
Treating SAT/UNSAT solver exit status as a proof
Dropping a partition or forbidden-multiset family after outcome access
Changing symmetry rules after seeing a survivor
Continuing past a verified witness in search of a preferred conclusion
Calling repository CI external scientific independence
